_doc: Typed WorkspaceOperational request for xpp_create_form. Shape taken from a live read of the shipped RetailITWorkspace (10.0.4x): every pattern name, version, style and extended style below is what the metadata on disk actually carries.

Structure: optional ActionPane, optional WorkspacePageFilterGroup (a Group BEFORE the Tab), then ONE Tab (style FastTabs, ExtendedStyle tab_simpleFastTab) whose TabPages are the sections: SectionTiles, SectionTabbedList, optional SectionStackedChart (dynamics-xpp:xpp-workspace-charts), optional SectionPowerBI, SectionRelatedLinks.

Build order: the list parts (FormPart forms + their Display menu items) and the AxTiles + their menu items must exist BEFORE this form is created; a SectionTabbedList tab page with no FormPartControl fails compile (PatternControlMissingChild).
Workspace forms have NO data sources. Substitute real tiles, parts, menu items and labels.
name: MyOperationalWorkspace

controls._doc: Optional page filter: ONE unbound control (set its extendedDataType directly) in a Group with the WorkspacePageFilterGroup pattern, placed BEFORE the Tab. See the skill for how its value reaches tiles and parts.
controls.name: WorkspaceFilterGroup

controls._doc: Section Tiles. Count/KPI tiles are MenuFunctionButtons whose extension is TileButtonControl pointing at an AxTile (dynamics-xpp:xpp-tile). A chart tile is a Container/FormPartControl instead (dynamics-xpp:xpp-workspace-charts). ArrangeMethod + ExtendedStyle are required by the pattern and not caught at write time.
controls.name: Summary
controls.caption: @MyLabels:Summary

controls._doc: Section Tabbed List: an inner Tab with VerticalTabs style; each inner TabPage holds exactly one Container/FormPartControl whose targetName is the DISPLAY MENU ITEM of a FormPartSectionList form. Both size modes SizeToAvailable, the whole way down.
controls.name: ActiveWork
controls.caption: @MyLabels:ActiveWork

controls._doc: Section Related Links: Groups (one per link column, each with a caption) of MenuFunctionButtons with Style=Link + ButtonDisplay=TextOnly. Omit menuItemType for Display items (see dynamics-xpp:xpp-form-subpatterns).
controls.name: RelatedLinks
controls.caption: @MyLabels:Links
